decision_basis: FN-containing ECM/TSHR association, receptor localization, and altered hormone-stimulated adenylyl cyclase sensitivity support qualified-high noncanonical matrix-anchoring/modulatory relay/function evidence; FN1 is not represented as a soluble TSHR agonist.

The Fras1-Frem2-NPNT basement-membrane scaffold, alpha8beta1 presentation, and mouse renal Gdnf/morphogenesis outputs support qualified-high full scaffold/co-complex relay/function evidence; NPNT is the dominant ligand and native quaternary stoichiometry is unresolved.
